# samuelbaird.com: notes for working in this repo

Plain static HTML, CSS and JS on Vercel (`cleanUrls`, no build step on Vercel; it serves the repo as-is). Pages: home (`index.html`), `/about`, `/books`, `/collection`, `/data`, `/donate`, `/faq`, `/wishlist`, `/sacred-sites` (map, `photos/`, `sites/`, `traditions/`), `404.html`. `/learn` and `/scout` are private tools (`noindex` in `vercel.json`).

## Generated files

- `node scripts/build.mjs` pre-renders site data to HTML/CSV/JSON, regenerates the shared nav, footer and SEO head inside marker comments on every page, and writes `/about`, `/faq`, `/data`, `/sacred-sites/sites`, `/wishlist`, `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml` and `llms*.txt`. Edit the generator or the data, not the generated output, then re-run it and commit the result.
- `wishlist/data.json` is synced from Amazon by `scripts/fetch-wishlist.mjs` (scheduled in `.github/workflows/wishlist.yml`). Hand-set priorities live in `wishlist/priorities.json`.

## Branding must stay consistent with Latter-day Stats

This site and `latterdaystats.samuelbaird.com` (repo `Samuel-Baird/latter-day-stats`) are one visual family. Keep them looking the same.

- The source of truth is `BRANDING_AND_DESIGN.md` in the Latter-day Stats repo ("the Archive"). Read it before changing any UI here.
- `tokens.css` mirrors that site's dark tokens (`--background`, `--surface`, `--border`, `--accent`, `--honey`, `--radius` 3px) and fonts (Fraunces for headings, Inter for body). Change a value here only if it changes there too, and vice versa.
- One 3px radius, borders instead of shadows, small-caps labels, no pills, honey as the identity color and blue (`--accent`) for anything clickable.
- Every public page loads `tokens.css`, the glyph background (`bg/`) and `deseret.js`. New public pages must do the same. (`/learn` and `/scout` skip the background and reveal on purpose.)

## Deseret title reveal

- `deseret.js` is a vanilla port of `DeseretTitle` (`src/components/deseret-title.tsx` in Latter-day Stats). The page `<h1>` briefly shows in the Deseret alphabet, then "translates" into Latin. Its keyframes live in `tokens.css`. If the timing or keyframes change in one repo, change the other.
- Titles are transliterated phonetically, word by word, from the `WORDS` table in `deseret.js`. That table is generated by `node scripts/deseret-words.mjs` from the CMU Pronouncing Dictionary. Never edit it by hand; put corrections in `OVERRIDES` in that script.
- When you add a page or change an `<h1>`, re-run `scripts/deseret-words.mjs`. A title with a word missing from the table is left in Latin (no reveal) rather than spelled out letter by letter.
- It is decorative only: the Latin text stays in the HTML, and the reveal is skipped under `prefers-reduced-motion` or if the Deseret font doesn't load.
